attestations.note: His page carries no Viață tab and no Tropar tab; the one sentence it prints is «Sfântul Petroniu a fost, probabil, un ascet al deșertului, care s-a mutat la Domnul în pace.» Read 24 September 2026.

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 23ης Οκτωβρίου — «Όσιος Πετρώνιος»

attestations.note: The life page `https://www.saint.gr/2788/saint.aspx` heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 23 Οκτωβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day the folder already keeps for the Romanian church, and it says in one sentence what doxologia said in one: «Ο Όσιος Πετρώνιος ήταν μάλλον ασκητής της ερήμου, που απεβίωσε ειρηνικά» — the same hedged «μάλλον», probably, that the Romanian «probabil» carries. There is no year, no desert and no hymn, so nothing is added but the Greek name form, the couplet and this row. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue as printed by pravoslavno.rs (24 September 2026).
